feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 4:23am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Any patchy rain will soon clear to leave a fine day with sunny spells and mainly light winds, before heavy rain arrives tomorrow night alongside strengthening winds. Maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

Heavy rain on Friday morning will bring a risk of localised flooding, before clearing to leave sunny intervals and isolated showers for the afternoon. Strong northwesterly winds will occasionally touch gale force in exposed spots, mainly from late morning to late afternoon. Maximum temperature 12°C.

A band of heavy rain will arrive Saturday morning. This will clear to leave sunny/clear intervals alongside isolated showers in the evening. Winds will increase through the morning to become strong to gale force southerly or southwesterly, veering westerly or southwesterly by the evening, then increasing to gale or severe gale force by the overnight period. Maximum temperature 15°C.
